items.title: Dork pet
items.text: Your dork becomes a pet: it naps while you’re away, wiggles when you point at it, and earns new outfits the more days you spend together.

items.title: Looks
items.text: Grape, Mint, Peach, Bubblegum or Graphite instead of Derp’s blue, in light and dark.

items.title: Screenshot with stickers
items.text: Put your dork, googly eyes, the duck and more on a picture of a page, then save it.

items.title: Seasons
items.text: Now and then the season drifts down: snow, blossoms, sunshine or leaves, with hearts for Valentine’s Day and pumpkins for Halloween.

items.title: Download duck
items.text: A duck carries each download to the downloads button.

items.title: Doodle searches Google
items.text: Doodle’s results come from Google now, in Doodle’s own look, without Google’s AI or its Sign in, and dark while Derp is.
